notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {5}.
description:
Activate up to five mana-producing lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}.
Cast Machine God's Effigy by paying {4}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Peregrine Drake, except it's an artifact.
When Machine God's Effigy enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands you control.
Activate Machine God's Effigy by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Machine God's Effigy from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
